entities.summary: WASP-127 is an old G5-type star that is around 9.7 billion years old and located 524 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Sextans. It has a mass of 0.9 solar masses, a radius of 1.3 solar radii and a temperature of 5,842 Kelvin. There is so far one planet detected, a low-density sub-Saturn type.
